title: EpisodeSpec
description: ATOBench per-episode configuration. Replaces the env-var configuration mechanism (ATOBENCH_ABLATE_PRIMITIVE / ATOBENCH_COUPLING_VARIANT / ATOBENCH_BASELINE / ATOBENCH_TASK) with a versioned, declarative contract. Schema version is bumped on every breaking change; see atobench/schema/CHANGELOG.md.

episode_id.description: Unique episode identifier, format ep_<6+ hex>. Used in turns.jsonl, episode_summary.json, and orchestrator logs.

task_id.description: Task identifier. T1=single-service flag capture; T2=multi-service OIDC; T3=pentest audit (FP/FN/TP/TN); T4=DVWA real-target validation (Phase 2.4).

baseline.description: Counterfactual baseline. B0=truthful; B1=single-turn; B2=50% inconsistent; B3=committed cross-turn-consistent D_t.

primitive_config.description: List of active deception primitives. Empty for B0. Multiple entries allow orchestrated multi-primitive episodes (generator-driven).

coupling_variant.description: Coupling-strength axis value. Partial order: signal_removal < loose < {schema_coupled ≈ precondition}.

params.description: Optional primitive-specific parameters (e.g., fake version string, target endpoint). Default: {}.

ablated_primitives.description: Primitives to ablate (force B0 behavior on affected endpoints). Used for M6 L4 counterfactual cells. Default: [].

defense_posture.description: T3 anti-injection defense posture. none=T1/T2 (no defense prompt); strong=full anti-injection instructions; weak=relaxed.

wall_clock_s.description: Wall-clock budget per episode, seconds. Default: 900 (15 min).

max_tokens.description: Optional LLM token budget. null = unlimited.

seed.description: RNG seed for B2 stochastic deception and bootstrap CIs. Must be reproducible.

agent.description: Agent driver configuration. Identifies which BaseAgent adapter to instantiate.

subagent.description: Optional subagent name for Claude Code (e.g., 'agentic-pentest-benchmark'). null for direct LLM agents.

task_overrides.description: Optional per-task parameter overrides (e.g., specific vuln IDs for T3). Default: {}.

run_idx.description: Optional run index for sweep bookkeeping. null for ad-hoc runs.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable annotation. Ignored by the runner. Default: null.
